scheme_name: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
other_conditions: Group must consist of 8 to 10 members who are adult farmers from the same village
All members must have a common bank account
The group must apply jointly with the signatures of each member on the application form
Only one member per family is allowed in the group
benefits_summary: Provides a tractor (including accessories) to a group of 8‑10 adult farmers at a subsidized rate, with a 70% subsidy up to Rs 5.5 lakhs.
